Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human Cytochrome P450 3A4. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary, filtering on target_dictionary.pref_name = 'Cytochrome P450 3A4' and target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical SMILES. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
